events.title: Thursdays are Casual
events.description:
Thursdays are Casual is a recurring house music party built to set the vibes right for the weekend. We believe the best music nights are the ones where everyone feels welcome: free entrance, warm energy, and DJs who keep the room lifted. Expect house and disco early in the evening, progressing into tech house later on for anyone ready to keep things moving. Come through, dance with us, and start your weekend with a smile.

——— 

At Thursdays are Casual we practice kindness, openness, and consent

events.title: Compilations by Caire
events.description:
Caire is the curator and mind behind Compilations, a personal archival practice in which she meditates on the sounds and designs of the Gen X Soft Club and Zen X aesthetic movements of the late 90s/ early 2000s. Caire will seek to highlight the balearic beat, downtempo, trip hop, nu bossa, and lounge sounds that have shaped her sonic and aesthetic sensibilities.

Caire is a curator and sensorial designer who focuses on crafting immersive experiences through sound, design, and space.
